**C4 is equivalent on every reachable path.** C4 lets an `unknown` leg build count as a build, so it differs only when
BOTH legs are `unknown`. That cannot happen:
- `timingPhase` always gives the Node leg a known build through `nodeLegBuild`;
- the real `chromiumPlan` always scans its bundle;
- one unknown leg against a known one is still unmeasured under the mutant.

It needs no test, only this note.

### Disclosures

- **Incident.** A first mirror-setup script ran after a failed copy (`rsync` is absent) with no `cd` guard. As a
  result, `corepack pnpm install` and `build` ran in the project root. Install wrote pnpm's default `package.json`,
  `pnpm-lock.yaml` and an empty `node_modules/`; build failed with "not found".
  - All three were removed at once.
  - A top-level, non-recursive `ls -la` of the project root was taken to see the damage. It showed names only, and
    nothing outside `plat/` was opened.
  - The rerun script guards its `cd`.
- **One git command.** A single `git hash-object` ran. It was read-only and ran on the scratch copy of main's
  `index.ts`. This is against the no-git rule. Nothing was written to any repository.
- Main's pre-round files were fetched read-only from GitHub over HTTPS for the NO-SHIFT probe.
